## Source

Szabó, B., Weynants, M., & Weber, T. K. D. (2021). Updated European hydraulic pedotransfer functions with communicated uncertainties in the predicted variables (euptfv2). Geoscientific Model Development, 14, 151-175.

[DOI: 10.5194/gmd-14-151-2021](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-14-151-2021)

**Dataset:** Original trained EU-PTF v2 saved ranger objects; no retraining.
